# Breached

> AI-powered digital identity leak scanner. Check whether an email address has been exposed in a data breach, and get an AI-generated risk score with clear steps to reduce exposure.

Breached queries DeHashed and Have I Been Pwned to check an email address against known data breaches, then produces an AI-scored risk assessment explaining what was found and what to do about it. Scanning is free and does not require an account; signing in unlocks full results, ongoing breach monitoring, and a dashboard.

## Pages

- [Home](https://www.breachdata.online/): Overview and entry point for scanning an email.
- [Scan](https://www.breachdata.online/scan): Start a breach scan for an email address.
- [Security Basics](https://www.breachdata.online/modules): Educational modules on account security.
- [Breach Intelligence](https://www.breachdata.online/breach-intelligence): Directory of documented data breaches.
- [FAQ](https://www.breachdata.online/faq): Frequently asked questions.
- [Terms of Use](https://www.breachdata.online/terms): Terms governing use of the service.
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.breachdata.online/privacy): What data is collected and how it is used.
